args: Check only the supplied conservative high-alignment finger envelope in BOTH current views. Identify each distinct scene object/surface whose XY footprint overlaps it, including the bowl and bottle if relevant. Return high0..high(count-1) pixel selectors on their actual highest visible points. Samples are upper extrema only if the entire relevant upper silhouette supports that interpretation; an arbitrary surface sample is not a height bound. At most four objects; otherwise too_many. Coverage complete requires all relevant surfaces and their upper extrema observable, not extrapolated through occlusion. Set robot_clear=visible_clear only if the images additionally support unobstructed motion of the visible hand/palm along this short high path. Do not certify hidden arm clearance or clearance for descent. If high volume is occupied use obstructed. Unused selectors must have visible=false. A retry must use a genuinely different visible sample addressing the previous error, or report unknown.

envelope.scope: Open fingers, high alignment and downward-tool world-yaw rotation only; no descent.

next_approach_envelope.scope: Open fingers, high alignment and downward-tool world-yaw rotation only; no descent.

result.explanation: Four overlapping objects/surfaces: high0 bowl, high1 bottle, high2 plate, and high3 stone worktop. The complete bowl rim, bottle cork top, and plate rim are observable across the two views and support upper-extremum selections; the exposed worktop supports a locally level planar upper surface. The plate overlaps the positive-X end of the supplied XY envelope. No external object occupies the high finger volume. The visible hand/palm has a clear short high sweep; this assessment excludes descent and hidden arm clearance.
